items.title: Curricular Practical Training (CPT) Lawsuit
items.zh_title: CPT诉讼：高校组织起诉联邦政府
items.zh_points: 10月5日一批高教组织就CPT新规起诉联邦政府，ISS持续跟进并在此更新。F-1同学请关注ISS通知，暂勿自行申请。
items.en_points: Higher-ed groups sued the federal government Oct. 5 over new CPT rules; ISS is tracking it and posting updates. F-1 students: follow ISS and don't apply on your own yet.

items.title: Federal Immigration Update: Curricular Practical Training (CPT) 8/25/26
items.zh_title: 联邦移民更新：CPT授权条件收紧
items.zh_points: 据SEVP澄清，硕博生只有在录取项目要求所有人完成实践训练时才能授权CPT。论文阶段的同学可能无法获批，请尽快咨询ISS。
items.en_points: Per SEVP, grad students can get CPT only if their program requires practical training of everyone. Dissertation-stage students may be denied; consult ISS soon.

items.title: A message about sexual violence prevention and support from Vice Chancellor for Student Affairs Lori Reesor
items.zh_title: 学生事务副校长谈性暴力预防与支持
items.zh_points: 校方重申认真对待每份性不当行为报告，并向全体学生群发邮件说明预防和支持资源。建议了解求助渠道。
items.en_points: UW says it takes every sexual misconduct report seriously and emailed all students about prevention and support resources. Know where to get help.

items.title: September 14, 2026: Duration of Status (D/S) rule change temporarily paused
items.zh_title: D/S新规被法院临时叫停
items.zh_points: 联邦法官9月14日发初步禁令，D/S（在校身份期限）规则不会按原计划9月15日生效。F/J学生暂不受新规影响，仍需关注后续。
items.en_points: A federal judge's Sept. 14 preliminary injunction stops the D/S (duration of status) rule from taking effect Sept. 15. F/J students are unaffected for now; stay tuned.

items.title: Health Alert: Measles Cases in Wisconsin
items.zh_title: UHS警报：威州麻疹病例增多
items.zh_points: 截至9月11日威州已确诊155例。疑似麻疹请居家，皮疹遮盖戴口罩，就诊前先打608-265-5600(选项1)。
items.en_points: Wisconsin had 155 confirmed cases as of Sept. 11. If you suspect measles, stay home, cover any rash, wear a mask, and call 608-265-5600 (option 1) before a visit.

items.title: Langdon Street’s legacy: racism still present today
items.zh_title: 校报：Langdon街希腊社团仍存种族歧视
items.zh_points: 据匿名学生证词，UW希腊社团文化中仍有种族主义。想加入社团的同学可多了解相关背景。
items.en_points: Anonymous student accounts say racism persists in UW Greek life. Students thinking of joining should learn the background first.

items.title: Delta expects higher fares and strong demand through the holiday season
items.zh_title: 达美预计假期机票涨价、需求旺
items.zh_points: 燃油成本大涨，票价走高但订票不减。回国或回家过节的同学建议尽早订票。
items.en_points: Fuel costs have surged and fares are rising, but bookings are holding up. Students flying home for the holidays should book early.

items.title: Spotting AI-generated scams and fraud
items.zh_title: 如何识别AI生成的诈骗
items.zh_points: 视频介绍辨别AI伪造内容的迹象。留学生是诈骗高发群体，遇到可疑电话或信息要多核实。
items.en_points: Video covers signs of AI-faked content. International students are frequent scam targets, so double-check suspicious calls or messages.

items.title: UW-Madison’s summer water main break cost nearly $16 million
items.zh_title: UW-Madison夏季水管爆裂损失近1600万美元
items.zh_points: 6月水管爆裂使4万多加仑湖水涌上校园街道。费用较高，但目前未提及对学费的影响。
items.en_points: The June break sent over 40,000 gallons of lake water onto campus streets. The cost is high, but no effect on tuition has been mentioned.

items.title: UW introduces new position within Fraternity and Sorority life to address sexual violence in the community
items.zh_title: 校方在兄弟会姐妹会办公室增设防暴力岗位
items.zh_points: 学校联合UHS，在兄弟会/姐妹会办公室设预防性暴力、酗酒和霸凌的新岗位，周四已邮件通知全体学生。
items.en_points: UW and UHS are adding a role in the Fraternity and Sorority Life office to prevent sexual violence, heavy drinking and bullying. All students were emailed Thursday.

items.title: David Crowley announces student renter protections in new renters plan
items.zh_title: 州长候选人提出学生租客权利法案
items.zh_points: 民主党候选人Crowley提议保护学生租客，防止被迫提前签约、克扣押金和不公平的室友连带责任。目前只是竞选承诺。
items.en_points: Democratic candidate Crowley proposes protecting student renters from forced early leasing, withheld deposits and unfair roommate liability. Just a campaign pledge.

items.title: US freezes green-card claims
items.zh_title: 美国冻结绿卡申请
items.zh_points: 报道标题称美国冻结绿卡申请，无正文细节，具体范围不明。想办绿卡的同学请查官方消息或咨询ISS。
items.en_points: The headline says the US froze green-card applications; no details, scope unclear. If you plan to apply, check official sources or ask ISS.

items.title: UW-Madison announces new position to open dealing with sexual misconduct
items.zh_title: UW将设性不当行为预防新岗位
items.zh_points: 副校长Reesor宣布在兄弟会/姐妹会办公室设新岗位，应对性暴力、霸凌和酗酒问题。
items.en_points: Vice Chancellor Reesor announced a new role in the Fraternity and Sorority Life office to address sexual violence, bullying and heavy drinking.

items.title: Save the date: Oct. 23 Nobel Prize celebration
items.zh_title: 10月23日诺贝尔奖庆祝讲座
items.zh_points: 10月23日下午2:30到4点在Morgridge Hall 7560有Halzen教授诺奖讲座，之后有茶会，欢迎所有人。
items.en_points: Prof. Halzen gives a Nobel lecture Oct. 23, 2:30 to 4 pm in Morgridge Hall 7560, followed by a tea reception. All are welcome.

items.title: UW-Madison professor wins Nobel Prize in physics
items.zh_title: UW教授Halzen获诺贝尔物理学奖
items.zh_points: 物理系教授Francis Halzen因领导南极IceCube中微子探测器获奖。本校第一手喜讯。
items.en_points: Physics professor Francis Halzen won for leading the IceCube neutrino detector in Antarctica. Firsthand good news for UW.

items.title: Reducing Drug-Related Harm on Campus
items.zh_title: UHS：减少校园药物伤害
items.zh_points: UHS介绍药物预防项目，提醒合成阿片类药物的过量风险，并提供减害资源和教育。
items.en_points: UHS outlines its drug prevention programs, warns of overdose risk from synthetic opioids, and offers harm reduction resources and education.

items.title: University of Wisconsin–Madison Professor Francis Halzen named 2026 Nobel laureate in physics
items.zh_title: Halzen教授获2026诺贝尔物理学奖
items.zh_points: Halzen是全球最大望远镜NSF IceCube的首席研究员，10月6日获奖。
items.en_points: Halzen, principal investigator of NSF IceCube, the world's largest telescope, was named a laureate on Oct. 6.

items.title: Impact of “pocket rescissions” on IFLE programs
items.zh_title: “口袋撤销”削减国际外语教育经费
items.zh_points: 白宫9月25日撤销含7000万美元IFLE拨款，可能影响国家资源中心和FLAS奖学金。语言区域研究方向的同学需关注。
items.en_points: A Sept. 25 White House rescission included $70M in IFLE funding, which may hit National Resource Centers and FLAS fellowships. Language and area studies students, take note.

items.title: Stay up-to-date on campus enrollment dates & deadlines with new Outlook calendar
items.zh_title: 教务处推出选课日期共享日历
items.zh_points: 秋季起，15周学期的选课日期在Outlook共享日历“RO Enrollment Dates & Deadlines”中，订阅后可看到。
items.en_points: From fall on, 15-week term enrollment dates are in the shared Outlook calendar 'RO Enrollment Dates & Deadlines'; subscribe to see them.

items.title: Bike and E-Scooter Theft — Awareness and Prevention
items.zh_title: UWPD提醒：电动车和滑板车失窃
items.zh_points: 8月27日至9月2日有三起电动车失窃，地点在Witte、Union South、Chadbourne外。开学季偷窃增多，请锁好车。有线索可打608-264-2677。
items.en_points: Three e-bike thefts Aug. 27 to Sept. 2 outside Witte, Union South and Chadbourne. Thefts rise as school starts, so lock up; tips to 608-264-2677.

items.title: Safety Information & Resources
items.zh_title: UWPD：开学安全信息与资源
items.zh_points: UWPD提醒校内外都有犯罪风险，介绍预防、执法和受害者支持项目。建议收藏安全资源。
items.en_points: UWPD warns crime risks exist on and off campus and outlines its prevention, enforcement and victim support programs. Bookmark the safety resources.

items.title: Teaching Academy Fall Retreat Using AI Critically & Creatively
items.zh_title: 教学学院秋季研讨：批判且创造性地用AI
items.zh_points: 面向教师和助教的AI教学研讨会，在DeLuca Forum举行。学生可借此了解课程中AI使用的趋势。
items.en_points: AI-in-teaching workshop for faculty and TAs at DeLuca Forum. Students can get a sense of how AI use in courses is trending.

items.title: Ottoman and Turkish Studies Association (OTSA) Conference October 9-11, 2026 Professor Kemal H. Karpat and his Legacy: Professor Hakan Kirimli (Bilkent University)
items.zh_title: 奥斯曼与土耳其研究协会年会（10/9-11）
items.zh_points: Pyle Center 225室，今天9点至17:30，免费公开。对历史、人文方向感兴趣的同学可以去听。
items.en_points: Pyle Center Room 225, today 9:00-17:30, free and open to the public. Worth attending for students into history or the humanities.

items.title: Lead Climbing Clinics
items.zh_title: Mt. Mendota 先锋攀岩培训
items.zh_points: 在Bakke中心3楼，9点至中午，学生$10。需已有Top Rope保护认证并能攀5.9。
items.en_points: Bakke Center 3rd floor, 9 a.m. to noon, $10 for students. Requires top-rope belay certification and the ability to climb 5.9.

items.title: Here's what to know about the 3 constitutional amendments on the Nov. 3 ballot
items.zh_title: 11月3日选票上的三项宪法修正案
items.zh_points: 州报解读选票上的三项修正案。只有美国公民可投票，国际生了解即可。
items.en_points: The State Journal explains the three amendments on the ballot. Only U.S. citizens can vote; international students can just stay informed.

items.title: 15-year-old shot, 2 arrested in East Side robbery: Madison police
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊东区抢劫案：15岁少年中枪，2人被捕
items.zh_points: 案发于East High School附近，警方已抓获两名嫌疑人。住东区的同学夜间出行注意安全。
items.en_points: It happened near East High School, and police have arrested two suspects. Students living on the East Side should stay safe at night.

items.title: Fall temperatures take the weekend off
items.zh_title: 周末回暖：周六气温升至80°F以上
items.zh_points: 今天有零星阵雨，周六气温可达80°F（约27°C）以上，下周多轮降雨。
items.en_points: Scattered showers today; Saturday could top 80°F (about 27°C), with several rounds of rain next week.

items.title: Tony Evers appoints UW-River Falls student to Board of Regents
items.zh_title: 州长任命River Falls学生为UW系统理事
items.zh_points: 18名理事中有两名学生，任期两年。学生理事会参与学费等UW系统决策。
items.en_points: Two of the 18 regents are students, serving two-year terms. Student regents help make UW System decisions such as tuition.

items.title: New name, same aim for Madison’s Traffic Engineering Division
items.zh_title: 麦迪逊交通工程部改名“出行与基础设施部”
items.zh_points: 改名是为了涵盖各种出行方式，职能不变。骑行、公交出行的同学可留意后续动态。
items.en_points: The new name is meant to cover all modes of travel; its duties stay the same. Students who bike or ride the bus may want to follow updates.

items.title: ‘Great Pumpkin Giveaway’ returns to Fitchburg
items.zh_title: Fitchburg“送南瓜”活动周六举行
items.zh_points: 周六9点至中午，Oak Bank提供马车游、选南瓜等，为GiGi’s Playhouse公益。想体验秋季活动可去。
items.en_points: Saturday 9 a.m. to noon: Oak Bank offers wagon rides, pumpkin picking and more to benefit GiGi's Playhouse. A good pick for a fall outing.

items.title: A few showers this afternoon before big warm-up
items.zh_title: 今天午后有阵雨，随后大幅升温
items.zh_points: 南威州约11点至18、19点有阵雨，可能有局部强降雨。出门带伞。
items.en_points: Showers across southern Wisconsin from about 11 a.m. to 6-7 p.m., with possible local downpours. Bring an umbrella.

items.title: Intro to Wheel Pottery
items.zh_title: 陶艺拉坯入门课
items.zh_points: 课程教拉坯、上釉，学费含12.5磅黏土和工具，课后两周可免费用工作室。想体验手作的同学可关注。
items.en_points: Learn wheel throwing and glazing; the fee covers 12.5 lb of clay and tools, plus two weeks of free studio use after class. Worth a look if you like crafts.

items.title: Frid-ai Reading Group: A Typology of Typos: Detecting Hallucinated Legal Citations Is Harder Than You Think A presentation by Prof. Ben Sobel, an Assistant Professor of Law at UW Law School
items.zh_title: AI读书会：AI幻觉法律引用难检测
items.zh_points: 法学院教授Sobel讲AI编造法律引文为何难识别，今天中午在University Club 313举行。
items.en_points: Law professor Sobel explains why AI-fabricated legal citations are hard to spot. Today at noon in University Club 313.

items.title: FAFSA Frenzy
items.zh_title: FAFSA 现场答疑，提供午餐
items.zh_points: 学生资助办公室在Bascom Hall B47现场帮忙填FAFSA并答疑。FAFSA主要面向美国公民/永久居民。
items.en_points: The financial aid office helps fill out the FAFSA and answers questions in person at Bascom Hall B47. FAFSA is mainly for US citizens/permanent residents.

items.title: Peer Support Drop-In Hours w/ Badger Supports
items.zh_title: Badger Supports 同伴支持开放时间
items.zh_points: 今天11点到中午在学生心理健康中心(Student Activity Center 3203)，可免费咨询校内资源、领贴纸和转介卡。
items.en_points: Today 11 am to noon at the student mental health center (Student Activity Center 3203): free help with campus resources, plus stickers and referral cards.

items.title: Funding Study Abroad Virtual Info Session
items.zh_title: 留学项目资助线上说明会
items.zh_points: 讲交换项目费用、奖助学金和省钱办法，11点到中午Zoom线上举行，需在链接注册。
items.en_points: Covers exchange program costs, scholarships and grants, and ways to save. On Zoom 11 am to noon; register via the link.

items.title: R Programming 3: Data Visualization for Research Projects (online)
items.zh_title: R语言工作坊：ggplot2数据可视化
items.zh_points: 线上免费代码跟学工作坊，教ggplot2作图和自定义主题，需会R和dplyr基础，需提前注册。
items.en_points: Free online code-along workshop on ggplot2 plotting and custom themes. Requires basic R and dplyr; register in advance.

items.title: Depression and Anxiety Screening
items.zh_title: 抑郁焦虑筛查
items.zh_points: 今天10点到2点在East Campus Mall 333号7楼提供抑郁和焦虑筛查，想自测情绪状态可去。
items.en_points: Depression and anxiety screening today 10 am to 2 pm at 333 East Campus Mall, 7th floor. Drop in if you want to check your mood.

items.title: 'Yes' for Reedsburg; 'no' on amendments
items.zh_title: 读者来信：11月3日三项州宪法修正案
items.zh_points: 读者提到11月3日选票上有三项威州宪法修正案，选民联盟建议全投反对。有投票资格的同学可提前了解。
items.en_points: A reader notes three Wisconsin constitutional amendments on the Nov. 3 ballot; a voter league urges a no vote on all. Eligible students can read up early.

items.title: Isaias gets stronger, heads to coastline
items.zh_title: 飓风Isaias增强逼近墨西哥湾沿岸
items.zh_points: 飓风周四增强，佛罗里达部分地区强制撤离。若近期要去墨西哥湾沿岸旅行，请留意。
items.en_points: The hurricane strengthened Thursday, with mandatory evacuations in parts of Florida. Take note if you plan to travel to the Gulf Coast soon.

items.title: Flu Season Is Here: 3 Steps to Take Now
items.zh_title: 流感季来了：现在该做的三件事
items.zh_points: 建议秋季早点接种年度流感疫苗。校内可到UHS预约接种。
items.en_points: Get your annual flu shot early in the fall. On campus, you can book one at UHS.

items.title: Flu Season Is Here: 3 Steps to Take Now
items.zh_title: 流感季来了：现在该做的三件事
items.zh_points: 介绍流感是传染性呼吸道疾病，分A、B两型，建议早接种疫苗。
items.en_points: Flu is a contagious respiratory illness with types A and B; the article recommends getting vaccinated early.

items.title: Showers this afternoon
items.zh_title: 今天下午有阵雨
items.zh_points: 麦迪逊今天下午有阵雨，出门带伞。
items.en_points: Showers in Madison this afternoon; bring an umbrella.

items.title: A few showers as things warm up this afternoon
items.zh_title: 下午阵雨，周末转暖如夏
items.zh_points: 今天下午有阵雨，随后迎来夏日般的暖和周末。出门带伞，周末适合户外。
items.en_points: Afternoon showers today, then a summer-like warm weekend. Bring an umbrella; the weekend is good for being outdoors.

items.title: Mamdani: 'ICE is rotten to its core'
items.zh_title: 纽约市长批评ICE执法枪击事件
items.zh_points: 纽约市长Mamdani称联邦移民执法人员的枪击事件是“暴行”，呼吁废除ICE。移民执法动向值得国际生关注。
items.en_points: NYC Mayor Mamdani called a shooting by federal immigration agents an 'atrocity' and urged abolishing ICE. Enforcement trends worth watching for international students.

items.title: Man shot and wounded by ICE agents during operation in New York City while in car with 5-year-old
items.zh_title: 纽约ICE行动中男子中枪受伤
items.zh_points: 纽约市10月8日移民执法人员开枪打伤一名车内带5岁孩子的男子，现场有抗议。注意移民执法风险。
items.en_points: On Oct. 8 in NYC, immigration agents shot and wounded a man in a car with a 5-year-old; protests broke out at the scene. Be aware of enforcement risks.

items.title: Hurricane Isaias shuts down nearly two-thirds of Gulf oil production; could affect gas prices
items.zh_title: 飓风致墨西哥湾产油停近三分之二
items.zh_points: 飓风不会直接影响威州，但能源设施受损后，中西部油价可能上涨。有车的同学留意加油开销。
items.en_points: The hurricane won't hit Wisconsin directly, but damaged energy facilities may push Midwest gas prices up. Students with cars should watch fuel costs.

items.title: Behind IceCube discoveries, decades of high-throughput computing
items.zh_title: IceCube诺奖背后的高通量计算
items.zh_points: UW和Morgridge研究所长期的计算支持，助力Halzen的IceCube研究，也参与过四项诺奖成果。
items.en_points: Long-term computing support from UW and the Morgridge Institute powered Halzen's IceCube research and also contributed to four Nobel-winning results.

items.title: UW–Madison’s METAL bootcamp inspires interest in metalworking for fun — and a stronger national future
items.zh_title: METAL金属加工训练营吸引参与者
items.zh_points: UW的四天金属加工训练营结合线上与线下教学。工程类同学若对金属加工感兴趣可关注。
items.en_points: UW's four-day metalworking bootcamp blends online and in-person teaching. Engineering students interested in metalworking may want to follow it.

items.title: Meet UW–Madison’s Nobel Prize winners
items.zh_title: 认识UW历届诺贝尔奖得主
items.zh_points: 回顾2026物理学奖得主Halzen及UW历代诺奖得主，他想在南极冰下建巨型望远镜。校园骄傲。
items.en_points: Profiles 2026 physics laureate Halzen and UW's past Nobel winners; he wants to build a giant telescope under Antarctic ice. Campus pride.

items.title: What new Dane County budget proposal could mean for students, community members
items.zh_title: Dane县2027预算提案：8.468亿美元
items.zh_points: 县长Agard提出2027年预算，继续投入平价住房并削减赤字。预算与租房和本地服务有关。
items.en_points: County Executive Agard proposed a 2027 budget that keeps funding affordable housing and cuts the deficit. It touches renting and local services.

items.title: Congrats to UW–Madison’s newest Nobel laureate: Francis Halzen
items.zh_title: 代理校长祝贺Halzen获诺奖
items.zh_points: 代理校长Wilcots发邮件祝贺物理系教授Halzen获2026诺贝尔物理学奖。
items.en_points: Interim Chancellor Wilcots emailed congratulations to physics professor Halzen on winning the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics.

items.title: Connecting Badgers: AI and Mental Health Transcript
items.zh_title: UHS播客：AI聊天机器人与心理健康
items.zh_points: UHS心理健康提供者讨论用AI聊天机器人求助何时有用、何时有风险。播客文字稿。
items.en_points: UHS mental health providers discuss when turning to AI chatbots for support helps and when it's risky. Podcast transcript.

items.title: UW–Madison to implement 2027 compensation strategy
items.zh_title: UW公布2027年薪酬策略
items.zh_points: 学校批准1250万美元用于调薪，重点提高低薪员工。主要影响教职工，兼职学生员工可留意。
items.en_points: UW approved $12.5 million for pay raises, focused on lower-paid employees. Mainly affects faculty and staff; student employees may want to take note.

items.title: Staying on Top of Your Mental Health
items.zh_title: UWPD：留意自己的心理健康
